title: Fixed Bin Assignment
description: Assigns an item to one fixed storage place (pick face) with its own replenishment thresholds (myWMS FixAssignment). The item-level min/max here wins over an area-level Topology-as-Code replenishment_strategy min/max for the same place. Does not reserve or book anything at runtime.

item_id.description: References an item id in MasterData-as-Code. The item's owner (if any) follows from MasterData.

storage_point.description: A compiled Topology-as-Code storage_point id, e.g. 'FIX.FIX-01-01'. A storage point is fixed to at most one item.

sequence.description: Order among several fixed places of the same item: 1 is filled and picked first. Unique per item.

uom.description: Unit of min_qty/max_qty/max_pick_qty, a MasterData-as-Code uom id. Omit to use the item's default_uom.

min_qty.description: Replenishment is triggered when the place falls below this quantity.

max_qty.description: Replenishment fills the place up to this quantity.

max_pick_qty.description: Largest quantity picked from this place in one pick; larger demands go to other stock (e.g. full cases from reserve). Optional.
